test_title: PYST 12: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Town M is to the north of Town B. Town C is to the west of Town B. Town D is to the north of Town C. Town D is to the south of Town A. Town A is to the west of Town M. What is the position of Town B with respect to Town A?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Town M is to the north of Town B. Town C is to the west of Town B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/751cb7e8216f44f8d972ac99d88aed8f0c4e0064cffe504e95d736fb4521c1ac.png] 

Step 2: Town D is to the north of Town C. Town D is to the south of Town A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bba8b62e903af2e469e47c1d75cb43175637299ce4b9f671ecea06fd7d861a19.png] 

Step 3: Town A is to the west of Town M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/270fba55373f5b91ef25ac5b2ae3408d6b2e444af72aded7c62ff888e8768f01.png] 

From the diagram, we can see that **the position of Town B with respect to Town A is South-east.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1).**
